supersedes: burst27-v1 (never run; tmpfs DB charged to the memory limit) and burst27-v2 (never run; its source 87dfeba carried the CR15a v1 read path that failed cr15a-after-v1)
status: Descriptive packet 27 input (baseline + noise), registered before any measured run. Selects no parameter.
purpose: Burst behaviour of the unchanged source-search path before CR15/c: latency, memory, task and retention peaks for N simultaneous unique-IMDb searches. Implementation plan 2.3/Q6: baseline+noise first; the UX/SLO frame (deadline, RAM budget, minimum admitted parallelism) is fixed in writing by the user before any packet 27 gate measurement and never fitted afterwards.

source.branch: wip/cr15b-cookie-scope-v2 (CR15a v2 714afa2 + 26a, landing base of packet 27)

path: TorrentSourceProviderService.find_by_imdb_id -> IndexerSearchService (12.5 s search timeout, tracker cache) -> shared synthetic BaseIndexerDefinition adapter (default semaphore 5, real IndexerClient, bounded download 48 MiB) -> _sync_torrent_files gather -> create_many (native parse, SQLite WAL on tmpfs). Only the adapter search parser is synthetic (one JSON page, 40 candidates).

mixes.typical: index 0 season-box (~1.36 MB, 1000 files), 1-5 remux (~410 KB), 6-15 pack (~104 KB), 16-39 movie (~51 KB); ~5.68 MB/search
mixes.heavy: typical, but every index divisible by 8 is giant-valid (~21.5 MB, 10000 files, natively accepted): stress profile, ~111.5 MB/search

resources.client: 2 CPU, cpuset 0,1 (one physical core), 1 GiB memory, no swap; SQLite DB on a fresh anonymous Docker volume per run (page cache, reclaimable)
resources.coexisting: G04 gate on cpuset 12-14 may still run; G03/CR15a must have finished before the first measured run

order: cell order rotated by one position per repetition; one fresh client and server process per run
warmup: one unsampled typical-mix search per process before the burst; burst starts all N searches on one event
metrics: cgroup anon peak delta over the post-warm-up level (20 ms sampler)
result correctness: 40 sources, 0 indexer errors, 40 unique info hashes per search
summary_rule: Per cell: median and range over repetitions of run p50/p95/max and anon peak delta; OOM count. Noise: per cell the spread (max-min) of the run p95 over repetitions is reported as the noise estimate. No pass/fail; no parameter is chosen here.
smoke_note: v1 wiring smoke and diagnostics, including heavy N=2 at 4 GiB (anon peak +572 MiB, memory.current +876 MiB incl. tmpfs DB) and a v2 volume-DB wiring diagnostic preceded registration and are not data.
